items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bunny and I were great friends. If I had a date, I would ask Bunny to play.

ctx.x: That’s right. Look at all the boys I’ve got with me today.
Joe Venuti once sent him a Christmas present: one cufflink. [laughter (Wingy had only one arm.)] And then the following year he sent him another cufflink, the same link. The other.
We’d do these. I did a few records. As a matter of fact, on Bunny—very . . . nobody knows this—on Bunny Berigan’s I Can’t Get Started, I played lead alto [saxophone] on that.
